what.description: Core fact - concise but complete (1-2 sentences)

when.description: When it happened. null if unknown.

where.description: Location if relevant. null if none.

who.description: People involved with relationships. null if general.

why.description: Context/significance if important. null if obvious.

fact_type.description: 'world' = objective/external facts, including user preferences, rules, corrections, and constraints even when stated during a conversation. 'experience' = actions, experiences, or observations the assistant/agent actually performed.

occurred_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for events; null otherwise

occurred_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for event end; null otherwise

time_expression.description: The temporal phrase exactly as the text wrote it (e.g. 'last spring'); null if none

entities.description: People, places, organizations, objects and concepts the fact names

name.description: The entity as the text names it

kind.description: One lowercase word: person, organization, place, ...; null if unclear

labels.description: Classification labels as key/value pairs; [] when no label applies or none are configured

key.description: Label key, or 'group:field' for a structured entity field

caused_by.description: 0-based indexes of EARLIER facts in this array that caused this fact (max 2); [] if none
